name: CL Crude Oil — EIA Inventory Report Reaction
description: Measures how crude oil (CL front-month) moves around the weekly EIA petroleum inventory report released Wednesdays at 10:30 AM ET. Uses a day-of-week + time-of-day proxy (no FRED calendar for EIA). Computes absolute returns at +1, +5, +15, and +30 minutes post-release. Outputs: average absolute return bar chart by horizon, summary statistics table, and event markers on each detected release.
source:
# CL Crude Oil — EIA Inventory Report Reaction Study
# EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report: Wednesdays 10:30 AM ET
# Proxy: day_of_week == 2 AND time_of_day == 630 (10:30 ET = 630 minutes)
# ~5% miss rate from holiday Thursday shifts — acceptable for this analysis

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
ts = index()

# --- EIA Release Detection (Wednesday 10:30 ET proxy) ---
day_of_week = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
time_of_day = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)

# Wednesday = 2 (0-based: Mon=0), 10:30 ET = 630 minutes from midnight
is_eia_bar = (day_of_week == 2) and (time_of_day == 630) and is_valid(close)

# --- Forward Returns at Each Horizon ---
# Absolute returns: |close[t+N] - close[t]| / close[t]
# Using << (lead) for research-only forward look
fwd_1m = abs((close << 1) - close) / close
fwd_5m = abs((close << 5) - close) / close
fwd_15m = abs((close << 15) - close) / close
fwd_30m = abs((close << 30) - close) / close

# Filter to EIA bars only (sparse — one value per Wednesday)
eia_fwd_1m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_1m)
eia_fwd_5m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_5m)
eia_fwd_15m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_15m)
eia_fwd_30m = where(is_eia_bar, fwd_30m)

# Also compute signed return for event markers (direction context)
signed_30m = where(is_eia_bar, ((close << 30) - close) / close)
direction = conditional_select(
    is_valid(signed_30m) and signed_30m > 0, "Bullish",
    is_valid(signed_30m) and signed_30m < 0, "Bearish",
    "Flat"
)

# Price at release for event marker context
eia_price = where(is_eia_bar, close)

# --- Output 1: Bar Chart — Avg Absolute Move by Horizon (Punchline) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='How Much Does CL Move After EIA? (Avg Absolute Return)',
    x_axis_label='Minutes After Release',
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='EIA Reaction',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 min', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+15 min', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30 min', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(eia_fwd_1m, eia_fwd_5m, eia_fwd_15m, eia_fwd_30m))

# --- Output 2: Summary Table — Stats per Horizon ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EIA Release Reaction Stats (Absolute Returns)',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['N (Events)', 'Median', 'Mean', 'Max', 'Min'],
        col_headers=['+1 min', '+5 min', '+15 min', '+30 min'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='EIA Reaction',
    order=0
)(eia_fwd_1m, eia_fwd_5m, eia_fwd_15m, eia_fwd_30m,
  eia_fwd_1m, eia_fwd_5m, eia_fwd_15m, eia_fwd_30m,
  eia_fwd_1m, eia_fwd_5m, eia_fwd_15m, eia_fwd_30m,
  eia_fwd_1m, eia_fwd_5m, eia_fwd_15m, eia_fwd_30m,
  eia_fwd_1m, eia_fwd_5m, eia_fwd_15m, eia_fwd_30m)

# --- Output 3: Event Markers — Each EIA Release ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.BellRingIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='30-Min Abs Move', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='5-Min Abs Move', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(direction, eia_fwd_30m, eia_price, eia_fwd_5m, is_eia_bar)
